temporal coverage

  • CURIE: gmeow:temporalCoverage
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/temporalCoverage
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/events
  • Box roles: CBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

The temporal extent or scope a creative work is ABOUT — the period its content covers, distinct from when the work itself was made.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CreativeWork -> gmeow:TimeInterval

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:temporalCoverage from gmeow:CreativeWork to gmeow:TimeInterval when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:CreativeWork, gmeow:TimeInterval

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for the period a gmeow:CreativeWork is ABOUT — the era a documentary covers, the span a history book treats — the dcterms:temporal analogue scoped to creative works.

Avoid when

  • Avoid confusing it with WHEN the work was created (that is a creation event's gmeow:eventInterval) or with an event's own dating; coverage is aboutness-of-time, not production time.

How to use

  • Point the gmeow:CreativeWork at a gmeow:TimeInterval via gmeow:temporalCoverage; reuse the temporal module's interval rather than minting a parallel span.

Examples

  • ex:documentary gmeow:temporalCoverage ex:ww2Period.
